title: Apocha task manifest
description: One unit of agent work. A task names checks from the project catalog; it can never supply commands.

allowed_paths.description: Paths the implementer may change. Directory scopes end in '/'.

read_only_paths.description: Paths the agents may read but never change.

protected_paths.description: Extra paths that must not change, on top of the project's protected and governance paths.

initial_context.description: Files placed in the implementer's first prompt. Must be readable paths.

design_reference.description: Approved, read-only reference files given to both roles. Must sit under the project's design_reference_prefix.

checks.description: Check IDs from the project catalog. Omit to select checks from the project's check_selection rules.
